title: Declare condition-name leaves under non-condition field names (creature conditionImmunities, magic-item state/ends/endsOn)
description: eshyra-o9bd.19.3.5.1 declared every leaf named condition/conditions[]/failedSaveCondition outside condition records, but condition names also appear under other field names with no relationship declaration: creature /conditionImmunities (35 leaves), magic-item /mechanics/effects/*/state (invisible x2: Dust of Disappearance, Potion of Invisibility), /mechanics/effects/*/ends/* (poisoned x2), /mechanics/effects/*/variants/whip/endsOn/* (incapacitated: Feather Token). Query records.json for exact membership; declare each as a typed reference or explicit not-a-reference (state may be a derived state rather than a condition; check printed text), extend CONDITION_NAME_LEAF_POINTER_SHAPES in packages/core/src/rules/recordRelationships.ts.
notes:
PLAN (Captain 2026-11-07): declare every condition-name leaf under other field names, membership from a generated query (leads: creature /conditionImmunities/* (35); magic-item /mechanics/effects/*/state, /mechanics/effects/*/ends/*, /mechanics/effects/*/variants/*/endsOn/*). Use the declaration machinery from PR #724: record-name references with a relation that matches the printed meaning (for example immune for condition immunities; for ending triggers, a relation naming the ending, checked against source), or not-a-reference with a reason. Extend CONDITION_NAME_LEAF_POINTER_SHAPES with the new enumerated shapes, keeping it bounded. Regenerate; prove expansion with one discovery regression (a seeded creature with condition immunities reaches the condition).
Captain 2026-11-07: integrated (2b7ffacb y0us, 0168e885 1fx7) after own review and verify (exit 0, 7479 passed; pack exact). PR https://github.com/jbongaarts/eshyra/pull/728 (stacked on #724). Stays in_progress until merged.
